title: test-native

beats.say: Your phone is not going to ask if you finished anything.
So I stopped negotiating with it and locked the apps instead.
Finish something real, photograph it, and the AI checks you actually did it.
Only then do the minutes land.
My screen time dropped because scrolling finally had a price.
Drift is ninety nine cents a month after three free days, iPhone only.

postCaption: I got tired of negotiating with my own phone, so I built something that just says no until the work is done.
